### Goal
Eliminate completed billing-event retention and deduplicate CLI billing filters. PDF migration remains paused.

### Constraints and rules
Keep commits small. Paste exact test output, not paraphrases. Never lower BigQuery audit retention below 365 days; document savings. Integration jobs use `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is retired. Do not increase Celery visibility timeout. Credential rotation requires explicit authorization after Vault steps 1–3.

### Key decisions and facts
Removed shared `pending_events` aliasing by copying batches. Removed unused `BillingWorker._last_batch`, which retained charged payload dictionaries. Added shared `_add_billing_filters()` with explicit `dest="currency"`. Updated obsolete `args.filters` assertion.

### Ruled out
Longer Celery timeout, PDF work, and legacy invoice-rounding changes.

### Progress
Worker suite: exact result: `41 passed in 3.09s`. Full suite: `118 passed, 7 skipped in 8.74s`. CLI tests: `15 passed`. Command tests: `22 passed`. 5,000-batch reproduction: 7.3 MiB peak, 2.1 MiB retained, zero pending events. Prod DB secret apply exited 0.

### Next steps
Fix the remaining duplicate `--currency/-c` builder found by `invoice list --help`, then run exact CLI/full-suite output and commit changes separately.

### Goal
Migrate invoice PDF export in `ledgerly/exports/pdf.py` to the async job queue.

### Constraints and rules
Never reduce ledgerly audit-log BigQuery retention below 365 days; document cost reductions in `infra/bigquery-costs.md`. Invoice reconciliation timing must use `invoice_reconcile_seconds` with only `service`, `environment`, `status`, and `tenant_tier` labels.

### Key decisions and facts
Scheduler recurrence now combines local date/time with the schedule timezone before converting to UTC, preserving wall time across DST. Added spring-DST midnight and New York wall-time regression coverage. Timezone validation uses `ZoneInfo` without UTC fallback. Full suite: 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated legacy invoice-rounding failure. Currency rounding tests pass with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

### Ruled out
Do not alter the unrelated invoice rounding implementation/test yet. Do not propose audit-log retention reductions.

### Progress
Scheduler and billing tests: 31 passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. PDF export queue migration has not started. Production credential rotation was requested but its ordered procedure was not executed.

### Next steps
Inspect `ledgerly/exports/pdf.py`, queue interfaces, and tests; implement async export with focused tests. Treat credential rotation and rounding work as separate, explicitly authorized tasks.

### Goal
Fix JPY currency rounding so non-two-decimal currencies respect their minor units. PDF export migration is paused.

### Constraints and rules
Keep commits small. Never reduce audit-log BigQuery retention below 365 days; document savings in `infra/bigquery-costs.md`. Integration jobs must use `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is retired. Do not increase Celery visibility timeout to mask duplicate runs.

### Key decisions and facts
`round_money()` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP`; scale, zero, high-precision, mixed-input, default-places, and invalid-negative-scale cases pass. Full suite reached 184 passed, 2 skipped. Billing worker completed events were being removed before persistence; moving `pending_events.pop()` after `record_usage_event()` fixed retry retention.

### Ruled out
PDF migration and unrelated legacy invoice-rounding implementation changes. Longer Celery visibility timeout.

### Progress
Currency focused tests: 6 passed; Ruff passed. `test_retry_retention` passes. Temporary breakpoint remains in `process_batch()`; successive-batch debugging showed pending lengths 0 then 3.

### Next steps
Remove breakpoint, diagnose successive-batch state, run worker tests/full suite, then commit separately. Credential rotation stopped after Vault steps 1–3; securely continue only if explicitly authorized.
